title: Risk that Paid off....Love It and Saved Money
text: Risk that Paid off....Love It and Saved Money. I took a chance and ordered this from Amazon at half the price of other online retailers because I really liked it but not at a high price and it paid off....this is very sturdy, heavy, easy to assemble and looks great...just pay attention to the measurements because it is small but exactly the same as the other retailers so a great find and totally worth the risk.

product_metadata.title: Konya Urban Industrial Round Cocktail Table Brown
features: Goes anywhere round coffee table w/ display shelf
Overall: 32” W x 32” D x 17.5” H
description: Round up industrial style. Rustic chic rolls home with this round coffee table. Spacious tabletop and shelf store and display trinkets, board games, and conversation starters. White-limed burnt oak finish and cast-iron casters show off industrial flair, while the simple, round silhouette brings a minimalist touch. Work up a style wonder with this cocktail table centering your living room or den.
